entities.summary: Edmundo Madarang Abaya was a Filipino Catholic archbishop. He served as a priest from 1953 until 1978, when he was the bishop of Laoag. He was appointed as the archbishop of Nueva Segovia in 1999. He eventually retired in 2005.
